invariant: Ghost demo audience surface = Web Control Plane + Cliff in Slack. Internal developer/admin/proof tooling must never be promoted into the audience-facing demo without an explicit HAR-129 contract change approved by the product owner.

audience_surfaces.name: Web Control Plane
audience_surfaces.job: Play, account/world state, graph/state diffs, traces, evals, organizational knowledge/history inspection.

audience_surfaces.name: Cliff in Slack
audience_surfaces.job: Business-intelligence update, strategy chooser, selected complete action, relevant evals, human judgment and learning interaction; and Ask Cliff: free-form questions answered from the real data, in a direct message or in a thread under an @mention.

audience_flow.what: Historical organizational context is loaded; the control plane shows the current account/world state, and the next event is still withheld.
One held-out next event enters the real pipeline; the graph, the account state and the business understanding change, shown as real diffs.
Intelligence-building evals assess whether that understanding is supported by the evidence.
Cliff posts what changed in the account and why (Message 1).
Cliff posts three materially different, complete strategies, each already assessed by decision/action evals (Message 2).
The human chooses one; the same message expands in place to the complete selected action.
The human can edit the action, then sends it explicitly.
Cliff interprets the human judgment and asks the human to confirm or correct that interpretation (Message 3).
The confirmed feedback becomes organizational context; knowledge is formed or refined with provenance and scope.
A later chronological episode retrieves and uses that knowledge, the trace shows it, and the loop continues.

forbidden_terms.why: The seller-side mail domain is a data key the recorded extraction cassettes depend on; it never renders. Seller people show as '<name> · seller, Vendor Co.' with no address.
The product is named gtm_ai on every audience surface. Internal identifiers (GHOST_* env vars, ghost_worker, ghostctl) never render and do not match a whole-word 'ghost'.
The operator CLI is internal plumbing, never a product capability or demo step.
Test doubles and smoke drivers never reach the audience.
A shell script name in audience copy is a terminal step.
The audience never uses a command-line interface.
Once the demo begins no terminal is visible (HAR-129 Demo surface boundary).
Build and test runners are internal.
Database, migration and raw service commands are internal.
The verification entrypoint and its artifacts are internal acceptance plumbing, not demo UI (HAR-129 North-star acceptance, section A).
A/B/C experiments, their arms and B>A / B>C claims are out of scope for the current demo (HAR-129 section 16 step 36). Strategy letters and 'you chose B over A' are product copy.
Causal uplift and attribution are out of scope for the current demo. Business language such as a price uplift is product copy.
Negative-transfer experiments are out of scope for the current demo.
Irrelevant-knowledge injection is out of scope for the current demo. Rejecting inapplicable knowledge (an applicability eval) is in scope.
Counterfactual causal attribution is out of scope for the current demo.
